title: MicroservicePrd:CommunityAnonymous

_meta.purpose: Community Anonymous microservice PRD: verified-anonymous professional discussion product combining Blind/TeamBlind patterns — work-email-verified anonymity, company-scoped private channels, public cross-industry boards, salary and compensation data sharing, polls, AMAs, career advice — with planned anonymity-preserving architecture, strict work-context-only policy, and Workflow/Ontology/Foundry ecosystem integration. Real identity is never linked to anonymous posts in any queryable store.

acceptance_criteria.given: a verified employee posts in the anonymous company channel
acceptance_criteria.then: the stored artifact contains only an anonymous_author_token (a one-way hash unlinkable without the salt held in a separate HSM-backed vault); real user_id is never stored in the anonymous post table or search index

acceptance_criteria.given: an employer admin queries the company anonymous channel
acceptance_criteria.then: only aggregate stats (post count, topic distribution, sentiment trend) are returned; individual posts are NOT attributable to any employee; the API returns 403 for any individual-attribution query from an employer role

acceptance_criteria.given: a court order is received requiring identity disclosure
acceptance_criteria.when: the legal hold four-eyes procedure is executed
acceptance_criteria.then: two authorized compliance officers must approve; the HSM-backed salt vault is accessed; real identity is disclosed in a sealed audit package; the event is permanently recorded in the immutable audit chain

acceptance_criteria.given: a user verifies their work email for anonymous posting
acceptance_criteria.then: the verification link is one-time-use; the verified credential is stored in a separate verification vault that does NOT share a foreign key with the anonymous posts table; verification tokens expire after 24h

acceptance_criteria.given: a user shares salary or compensation data
acceptance_criteria.when: the data is stored and queried
acceptance_criteria.then: individual salary entries are stored with anonymous_author_token only; aggregate compensation data is returned for peer comparison; individual entry is never linkable to real identity in query path

acceptance_criteria.given: a content moderation action is taken on an anonymous post
acceptance_criteria.then: the moderator sees the anonymous_author_token (not real identity) for appeal processing; moderation decision is audit logged with anonymous_author_token; real identity is not surfaced to moderator

dual_context_isolation.mechanism: CommunityAnonymous is work-context only; anonymous_author_token is a one-way keyed hash (BLAKE3 with per-tenant salt stored in HSM-backed vault) with no foreign key relationship to any identity table; Cedar policy denies any query that attempts to join anonymous_author_token to user identity without four-eyes legal hold authorization

anonymity_architecture.salt_storage: HSM-backed KMS vault; separate from all application databases
anonymity_architecture.no_foreign_key_constraint: anonymous posts table has no FK to user identity table; join is physically impossible in query path
anonymity_architecture.legal_reveal_procedure: four-eyes HSM vault access with dual compliance officer approval; produces sealed audit package; emits ConnectAnonIdentityRevealed to immutable audit chain

cross_context_mediation.policy: Community Anonymous remains work-context only. Personal-to-work or work-to-personal movement is denied by default and may only occur through Workflow consent-token flows that emit aggregate-only Ontology projections.

Ontology aggregate topic projection with k-anonymity threshold k>=10

cross_context_mediation.personal_to_work: No personal anonymous posting surface exists. Personal artifacts cannot become anonymous work posts; only aggregate, consented topic signals may cross via Workflow and Ontology.
cross_context_mediation.work_to_personal: Anonymous work discussions never appear in personal feeds/search/suggestions. Aggregate compensation benchmarks may be exported only when cohort k>=10 and data-use consent is present.

stride.spoofing: Work-email verification tokens are one-time, expiring, and stored outside anonymous post records.
stride.tampering: Anonymous post and legal-hold events emit immutable audit-chain entries; moderation edits are append-only.
stride.repudiation: Moderation and legal-hold actions retain sealed audit evidence without exposing identity to normal moderators.
stride.information_disclosure: Identity joins are denied; aggregate dashboards require k>=10 and suppress rare cohorts.
stride.denial_of_service: Rate limits and abuse throttles apply to anonymous_author_token without revealing identity.
stride.elevation_of_privilege: Legal reveal requires dual compliance approval plus HSM vault access, never an employer-admin role.

linddun.linkability: Post, salary, poll, and moderation records use scoped anonymous_author_token values and no identity FK.
linddun.identifiability: Direct user identifiers are excluded from anonymous tables and search indexes.
linddun.non_repudiation: The system preserves legal-hold auditability while avoiding normal-path author attribution.
linddun.detectability: Membership verification is decoupled from visible posting activity.
linddun.disclosure_of_information: Aggregate APIs suppress small cohorts and rare-topic pivots.
linddun.unawareness: UX must disclose anonymity boundaries, legal-hold exceptions, and aggregate analytics behavior.
linddun.non_compliance: Regional packs must map PIPA/GDPR/CCPA/workplace-law obligations before GA.
